question: What is the new Starbucks® Rewards Multi-tier program?
answer: The Starbucks Rewards Multi-tier program gives you more benefits and flexibility. It is a tiered rewards program with three levels: 50, 100, and 150 Stars — so you can redeem sooner or save up for more.

question: What are the reward tiers and what does each include?
answer: There are 3 tiers: • 50 Stars — a drink customization (except Breve and 2oz Heavy Cream), or a bagel, glazed or chocolate dipped doughnut, or banana loaf • 100 Stars — any handcrafted drink or bakery item • 150 Stars — any pasta, sandwich, or cake slice

question: Are there any drinks or items not included in rewards?
answer: A few items sit outside redemptions to keep the program sustainable: ice cream-based beverages, Breve, and 2oz Heavy Cream at the 50★ tier; Traveler Kits and French Press at the 100★ tier. Everything else on the eligible menu is fair game.

question: Why is a cake redemption 150 Stars instead of 100 now?
answer: It's not about paying more — it's more choices. 50★ now unlocks a free drink customization or select bakery items. 100★ still covers the same handcrafted drink and bakery menu. 150★ keeps cake and adds two brand-new options: sandwich and pasta.

question: What happens to my existing Stars when the new program launches?
answer: Your Star balance carries over to the new program — nothing resets on July 21. Your Stars keep their original expiry date.

question: Will my Stars still be automatically converted to a reward at 100 Stars?
answer: No — and that's the upgrade. Instead of an automatic conversion at 100 Stars, you now choose when and what to redeem, starting at just 50 Stars. Redemption is done in the new Starbucks PH app before you order in store.

question: Do I need the new Starbucks PH app to redeem?
answer: Yes. Rewards are redeemed through the new Starbucks PH app, available on the App Store and Play Store starting July 21, 2026. You'll continue to earn Stars by paying with your registered Starbucks Card, with or without the app.

question: What if I can't find the new app on July 21?
answer: App Store and Google Play rollouts can reach devices at different times. Your Stars, vouchers, and Card balance are safe either way — the old app keeps working until the new one is confirmed available.

question: How do I redeem a reward?
answer: Open the Starbucks PH app, tap Rewards, choose the reward you want, and tap Use. Your reward voucher will appear under Available Rewards — show it when ordering in store. (Full step-by-step guide above.)

question: I ordered more than one eligible item — which one gets my reward?
answer: Your reward automatically applies to the highest-priced eligible item in your order.

question: How do I earn Stars?
answer: Pay with your registered Starbucks Card (physical or in the app) to earn 1 Star for every ₱25 spent on beverages, food, or merchandise in our stores. Stars cannot be earned on purchases of gift certificates, Starbucks Cards, or Starbucks Card reloads.

question: How do I earn Stars on Grab and Lazada?
answer: Link your Grab and Lazada accounts to your Starbucks Rewards account to earn 1 Star for every ₱40 spent on Starbucks orders via delivery or the official Starbucks Flagship store on Lazada, using any payment method.

question: When will Stars from Lazada orders be credited?
answer: Stars are credited to your account within 7 days of successful delivery. Stars from cancelled, returned, or refunded orders will be adjusted from your account.

question: Do I earn Stars on a purchase where I redeem a reward?
answer: Yes — you earn Stars on the amount you pay with your registered card. The redeemed item itself does not earn Stars.

question: How will I know how many Stars I have?
answer: You'll see your Star balance in the new Starbucks PH app.

question: Do Stars expire?
answer: Yes. Stars are valid for one (1) year and expire on your Anniversary Date each year if unused. Redeem them for rewards in the app before they expire.

question: How long do my reward vouchers last?
answer: A reward voucher is valid for 90 days from issuance. Once a voucher is issued, it cannot be converted back to Stars.

question: What happens to reward vouchers I already have?
answer: Existing vouchers remain valid until their original expiry date and can be used in store as usual.

question: Can I use a reward together with other promos or my PWD/Senior Citizen discount?
answer: Rewards cannot be combined with other promotions. PWD and Senior Citizen discounts cannot be applied to redeemed rewards (for example, a drink redeemed with a free customization), as these items are already redeemed using your Stars.

question: Can I still get my cup discount if I'm redeeming a reward?
answer: A reward already makes that item free, so the cup discount applies to what you're paying for instead. If more than one drink in your order has a personal cup, let your barista know so they can ring your redeemed and purchased drinks separately.

question: Are there size or customization limits on rewards?
answer: The 100-Star reward covers any handcrafted drink in any size; add-ons and customizations are charged separately.

question: Can I redeem rewards on delivery or online orders?
answer: Rewards can currently be redeemed in stores only. Grab and Lazada orders earn Stars, but rewards cannot be redeemed on those platforms.
